csv_project_name: Developer for Gastonia Multi-Family Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: It is the goal of the City of Gastonia to partner with community agencies, developers and contractors to create, develop and construct affordable, multi-family housing units. Priority is given to those parties approved by the North Carolina Housing Finance Agency through use of its LowIncome Housing Tax Credit which provides multiple funding sources and subsidy layering as an integral part of the HOME funds match requirements. This feature allows for the opportunity to create as many affordable housing units as feasibly possible while incorporating other sources of available funding. Activities/projects may be new construction or rehabilitation.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Housing & Urban Development, Redevelopment Planning

title: Developer for Gastonia Multi-Family Housing Development
short_description: Affordable multi-family housing development or rehabilitation in Gastonia, North Carolina.
project_scope: The City of Gastonia seeks a partner to create, develop, and construct affordable multi-family housing units. Projects may include new construction or rehabilitation. Priority is given to teams approved by the North Carolina Housing Finance Agency using Low-Income Housing Tax Credit funding and layered subsidy sources to maximize affordable housing delivery.
services: Design-build/developer services, rehabilitation and refurbishment, housing and urban development, redevelopment planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential multi-family housing is not a core sbp target sector.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or structurally innovative scope is indicated.
- Tender is primarily for developer/design-build partnership rather than specialized structural engineering.
- Possible rehabilitation component exists, but no technically demanding structural features are described.

fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. The notice is an advance notice for a developer/design-build partnership and does not provide a separable structural engineering fee.
references_qualifications: Priority is given to parties approved by the North Carolina Housing Finance Agency through use of its Low-Income Housing Tax Credit program. No further specific reference requirements are stated in the notice.
